## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, written before the code, and passing
- [ ] No personal data: no real crash dumps, event logs, user names, machine names or user-profile paths (fixtures are synthetic or redacted)
- [ ] User-facing text reviewed: plain language, no scare tactics, confidence stated where relevant
- [ ] For fix actions: `Describe`, `Apply`, `Verify` and `Undo` implemented, undo record saved before `Apply`, tested in Windows Sandbox or a VM
- [ ] Docs updated where needed (ADR, glossary, README, recipe docs)
- [ ] Touches `src/Sherlog.Service/`, the fix engine, IPC, the approved-actions list, signing or release workflows? If so, owner approval is required before merge
